The offering will comprise 2.05M to 4.24M units priced at $0.22 each, with each unit including one common share and one warrant.
Each warrant will carry a $0.30 exercise price and remain valid for 24 months, beginning 61 days after closing.
Proceeds will primarily fund uranium exploration at the Astro Uranium Project and Wyoming projects, along with G&A and working capital.
The financing is expected to close around October 16, 2026.

title: Global Uranium plans up to $933K private placement
